data.subject: Local Ledger: STHO public-record signal
data.body:
Hi,

Your June 30, 2026 13F shows positions in STHO, TRC, and PCYO.

On September 23, 2026, six Asbury Park City Council agenda items mentioned the Waterfront Redevelopment Area, Block 3801, and 320 Asbury Avenue (entitlement). (https://asburyparknj.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=5735,plainText=false)

Local Ledger is independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records—permits, agendas, call reports, and filings—with every claim cited.

I can offer the free weekly issue and a four-week fund pilot.

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
